note: The caller sizes z using 2*m_p_words+2 before Montgomery reduction, making the candidate input-dependent through the modulus size.
grow_to rounds the requested word count up to a multiple of 8, so the actual allocation may differ from the exact output_size assumption.
The reduction logic requires z to be at least 2*(p_size+1) words, but the caller only guarantees a rounded allocation from grow_to.
The loop writes and later reads z beyond the originally requested size when the allocation is insufficient for the assumed workspace layout.
